h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bellary

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bellary

items.pText: Bellary, now Ballari, is a hot, dry district town in north-east Karnataka, known for iron ore mining and as the gateway to Hampi. Summer temperatures run very high, and fine red dust from the mining belt settles on everything left outdoors. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, mining-company townships, housing colonies and parks in Bellary from our Vasai factory, about 640 km away.

Heat and dust together shape what we suggest here. A slide in full afternoon sun gets too hot to use, and dust works its way into moving parts such as bearings and springs. Our galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts stand up to both, but placement and cleaning make a large difference. We ask for site photos taken in the afternoon, so we can see where the shade falls.

richText.heading: Shade and dust control for a Bellary playground

c: Shade comes first. Use existing trees or buildings on the west side of the play area, or add a
nearby for parents and for children to rest. Lighter roto-moulded colours stay cooler in the sun than dark shades.

For dust, a hedge or a low wall on the windward side cuts down what blows onto the equipment. Hose down slides and decks every few days in the dry months. items.q: Which playground colours suit a very hot town?
items.a: Lighter shades such as yellow, light green and sky blue absorb less heat than dark red or navy. We offer 15+ roto-moulded shades, and we can suggest a light combination for your site.

items.q: Does mining dust damage playground equipment?
items.a: Dust does not harm galvanised steel or roto-moulded plastic, but grit wears bearings and springs over time. Regular cleaning and monthly checks keep moving parts working well.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Bellary?
items.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory, about 640 km away, and send it by road. Our team or a dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing.
